The '''2015 Copa Sudamericana elimination stages''' were played from August 11 to September 17, 2015. A total of 46 teams competed in the elimination stages to decide 15 of the 16 places in the [[2015 Copa Sudamericana final stages|final stages]] of the [[2015 Copa Sudamericana]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/reglamento_copa_sudamericana_2015.pdf|title=Copa Sudamericana 2015 – Reglamento|language=Spanish|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref>

==Draw==
The draw of the tournament was held on July 16, 2015, 20:00 [[UTC−04:00|UTC−4]], at the Salón Joao Havelange of the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/16092015-1824/quedo-establecido-el-calendario-de-la-copa-sudamericana-2015|title=Quedó establecido el calendario de la Copa Sudamericana 2015|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=July 16, 2015}}</ref>

For the first stage, the 32 teams were divided into two zones:
*'''South Zone:''' The 16 teams from Bolivia, Chile, Paraguay, and Uruguay were drawn into eight ties.
*'''North Zone:''' The 16 teams from Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, and Venezuela were drawn into eight ties.

Teams which qualified for berths 1 were drawn against teams which qualified for berths 4, and teams which qualified for berths 2 were drawn against teams which qualified for berths 3, with the former hosting the second leg in both cases. Teams from the same association could not be drawn into the same tie.

For the second stage, the 30 teams, including the 16 winners of the first stage (eight from South Zone, eight from North Zone), whose identity was not known at the time of the draw, and the 14 teams which entered the second stage, were divided into three sections:
*'''Winners of the first stage:''' The 16 winners of the first stage were drawn into eight ties, with the order of legs decided by draw. Teams from the same association could be drawn into the same tie.
*'''Brazil:''' The eight teams from Brazil were drawn into four ties. Teams which qualified for berths 1–4 were drawn against teams which qualified for berths 5–8, with the former hosting the second leg.
*'''Argentina:''' The six teams from Argentina were drawn into three ties. Teams which qualified for berths 1–3 were drawn against teams which qualified for berths 4–6, with the former hosting the second leg.

==Format==
In the elimination stages (first stage and second stage), each tie was played on a home-and-away [[two-legged tie|two-legged]] basis. If tied on aggregate, the [[away goals rule]] was used. If still tied, the [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] was used to determine the winner (no [[extra time (association football)|extra time]] was played). The 15 winners of the second stage (eight from winners of the first stage, four from Brazil, three from Argentina) advanced to the [[2015 Copa Sudamericana final stages|round of 16]] to join the defending champions ([[Club Atlético River Plate|River Plate]]).<ref name="regulations"/>

==First stage==
The first legs were played on August 11–13, and the second legs were played on August 18–20, 2015.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/16092015-1824/fue-establecido-el-calendario-de-la-primera-fase-de-la-copa-sudamericana|title=Fue establecido el calendario de la Primera Fase de la Copa Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=July 22, 2015|language=Spanish}}</ref>

==Second stage==
